no_outcome_promised.note: The draft restates the customer's request to remove the fee and stop future charges without promising either outcome.

no_liability_admitted.note: "We're sorry to hear this has been a worry for you" expresses empathy without conceding the fee was wrong or that notice was not given.

no_legal_conclusions.note: No law, regulation or regulator is mentioned.

no_invented_specifics.note: "A specialist team is reviewing it" describes an internal handling procedure that is not in the complaint. The 10-business-day timeframe is acceptable only if it is the bank's standard timeframe.

no_internal_disclosure.note: No flags, compliance review, priority, or automated or AI systems are mentioned. The "specialist team" line is close to this line and is addressed under other checks.

no_injected_instructions.note: The complaint contains no instructions aimed at an AI, and the draft follows none.

addresses_each_issue.note: The draft covers the $2.00 PAPER STMT FEE, the lack of notice, the preference for paper statements because the customer does not use a computer, and the request to remove the fee and not charge it again. It also acknowledges the length of the relationship and the granddaughter's help.

tone.note: "Dear Customer" feels scripted when the customer signed as ⟦NAME_1⟧. "We want you to know that a person has read it carefully" sounds odd and formulaic. "Carefully" appears twice.

mode_respected.note: "A specialist team is reviewing it" effectively points to a department or routing destination, which ACKNOWLEDGE ONLY mode does not allow. The rest correctly frames events as the customer's account ("Here is what you told us") and takes no position on the substance.

revision_instructions: Remove "A specialist team is reviewing it". Replace it with a neutral line that names no team or procedure, e.g. "We will look into what you have told us and respond within 10 business days". Keep the 10-business-day figure only if it is the bank's standard response timeframe.
Change the salutation from "Dear Customer" to "Dear ⟦NAME_1⟧".
Delete "and we want you to know that a person has read it carefully" and avoid repeating "carefully".
Optionally, warmly acknowledge the customer's long relationship with the bank. Do not mention their age in a way that could seem condescending.
